name: api_fishaudio_voice_clone_tts
title: Fish Audio: Voice Clone to Speech
summary: Clone any voice from a short recording, then use it to speak any script with Fish Audio. Record 2-3 clips of 15-20 seconds, connect them to the Instant Voice Clone node, and the cloned voice feeds straight into text to speech with no training wait. Add emotion tags to control how your cloned voice delivers each line. Great for personalized narration, character voices, and content in your own voice.
